Project Modules

We offer project studies (PS) for students of the programs Bachelor in Management & Technology (BMT) as well as Master in Management (MiM), according to the general guidelines that can be found in your study regulations (Fachprüfungs- und Studienordnung). PS teams should be 3-5 students.

You can apply for an open topic or with your own topic in case you already found a company and a topic. To apply, please send the following documents to lehre (dot) bais (at) mgt (dot) tum (dot) de :

  • curriculum vitae
  • transcript of records

  • proposal (1-3 pages, only necessary if you apply with your own topic)
